answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by capping attestation concentration: a verifier may countersign many answers, but only attestations spread across distinct, unrelated recipients count toward its reward, with a ceiling per recipient each epoch. A reciprocal ring that back-scratches, attesting only each other, earns nothing beyond the cap, while honest verifiers who sample the whole economy, like wind across a meadow, always find work. Coordinated voting needs a tight thread of favoritism, and the cap cuts it, so a gale of fake support disperses harmlessly instead of bending rewards.
